The Opportunity 
Are you passionate about power systems protection and eager to contribute to the energy transition? We are now looking for an experienced HVDC Protection Project Engineer to join our global HVDC team in Ludvika. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, implementing, and testing advanced protection systems that enable reliable and efficient transmission of electricity across the world. 
You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, customers, and suppliers to deliver innovative HVDC solutions that support grid stability and sustainable energy development. Teamwork is at the heart of how we work, and we believe that strong collaboration, communication, and a willingness to support and learn from others are just as important as technical expertise. We therefore place great value on your personal qualities, your ability to build strong relationships, and your motivation to contribute to the team’s success. 
This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 
How You'll Make an Impact 
Team leadership and alignment: Guide team members, coordinate activities, and keep the team’s technical direction and deliverables aligned with customer expectations. 
Customer understanding: Interpret customer specifications, identify key technical and functional requirements, and translate them into suitable technical solutions. 
Technical leadership: Apply a strong understanding of our products to develop and adapt solutions that meet customer needs and project requirements. 
Drive the specification, design, and engineering of HVDC protection systems for global projects. 
Perform protection studies, including fault calculations, relay coordination, and stability analyses for HVDC converter stations and transmission systems. 
Develop and review protection philosophies, functional specifications, logic diagrams, and test procedures. 
Configure and validate protection solutions to support reliable system performance. 
Participate in Factory System Tests and commissioning activities. 
Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to solve technical challenges and support successful project delivery. 
Share knowledge, contribute to continuous improvement, and support colleagues in their development. 

Your Background 
Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or related fields. 
Experience in protection engineering, ideally within HV or DC environment, FACTS, or power transmission. 
Understanding of HVDC technology, converter topologies (VSC and/or LCC), and protection principles is an advantage. 
Knowledge of high-voltage substation protection and control systems, including design, configuration, testing, or commissioning. 
Experience working with Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs), including configuration, testing, or troubleshooting. 
Familiarity with power system analysis tools such as PSCAD, PSS®E, or DIgSILENT PowerFactory. 
Experience working with Azure DevOps and applying Agile and Scrum methodologies 
Knowledge of relevant standards and protocols, such as IEC 61850 and IEC 60255. 
A collaborative and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively across disciplines and cultures. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. 

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​ 
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​

jobs.description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.
If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.
At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.
Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.
What you’ll do
As the Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead for Green Steel, you’ll bring together project information from Planning, Cost, Contracts, the EPCM contractor and other area teams. You’ll analyse this information to show how the project is performing, highlight trends and deviations, and provide clear reporting and recommendations to support decision-making.
Coordinate the collection, validation and integration of cost, contract, schedule, progress, quantity and resource information.
Analyse performance data to identify trends, variances, risks, opportunities and issues requiring action.
Prepare consolidated reports, dashboards and management summaries for the area.
Work with project teams and the EPCM contractor to align inputs and resolve gaps or discrepancies in reporting.
Follow up significant differences between reported progress and site execution, escalating issues where needed.
Support consistent project controls processes and reporting standards within the area.
Identify practical improvements to reporting, data quality and analysis, including opportunities to use automation and Power BI.
Provide technical guidance on integrated reporting and performance analysis, and support project reviews and assurance activities.

What you’ll bring
You’re analytical and comfortable working across different project disciplines. You can bring complex project information together, identify what it means for performance, and explain your findings clearly to different stakeholders.
Relevant experience in project controls, cost control, contract or commercial controls, or project performance reporting in a complex project environment.
Experience consolidating and analysing information across areas such as cost, schedule, progress, contracts, quantities or resources.
Experience working with EPCM contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.
Strong skills in trend and variance analysis, forecasting, progress measurement, and identifying risks and opportunities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and relevant project controls systems.
Knowledge of project controls governance and practices such as AACE or PMI.
Ability to turn complex data into clear reports, insights and recommendations.
Professional written and verbal communication skills in English.
A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. A project controls or cost management certification is an advantage.

Benefits at Stegra
At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.
You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.
This is Stegra
Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.
By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

jobs.description:
Your New Role 
We’re looking for an experienced learning design consultant to help our client build a global Retail Sales Academy.
You’ll translate an established sales job architecture and skills framework into role- and skill-based learning journeys for four profiles: Commercial Management, Account Management, Field Sales and Sales Enablement. The Academy will be delivered through the client’s Learning Experience Platform (LXP) and will support onboarding and ongoing development for approximately 1,500 employees across more than 20 markets.
You’ll start by identifying which existing resources can be reused or adapted. You’ll then build learning paths that give employees a clear progression, opportunities to practice in real sales situations, and support from managers and peers. English will be the master language, with local-language content where it helps employees apply what they learn. Spanish-language needs will be a particular focus as you design for rollout across Europe, North America and Latin America.
What you’ll do

Define the Academy’s structure, curriculum and learner navigation, including who will own and maintain it after launch.

Review internal and third-party learning content and map relevant resources to priority roles, skills and proficiency levels.

Design learning journeys with clear outcomes, a logical sequence, hands-on activities, manager coaching and peer learning.

Identify priority content gaps and adapt or develop materials where existing resources fall short.

Define a scalable localization approach, including how translated and adapted content will be quality-checked and maintained.

Prepare learning path specifications, taxonomy and metadata requirements for implementation in the LXP.

Deliver editable assets, documentation and knowledge transfer so the client’s teams can manage and update the Academy after handover.

Company Presentation
Our client is a leading global hygiene and health company operating in around 150 countries under several strong brands. They work to break barriers to well-being, combining innovation with a strong focus on sustainability, diversity, and inclusion. Through their efforts, they create value for customers, consumers, employees, and society at large.
Good to Know
Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Start date: As soon as possible. End date: 2027-04-15, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.
To succeed in this role, you will need: 
Strong experience designing corporate academies, structuring curricula and building role- or skill-based learning journeys aligned with business capabilities and proficiency levels.

Experience assessing large third-party learning libraries and selecting content based on quality, relevance and practical application. You know how to reuse and adapt existing resources and create new content where it fills a clear gap.

Experience designing learning for sales or commercial teams, with practical activities, manager coaching, peer learning and follow-up that help employees apply new skills on the job.

Experience with Cornerstone or a comparable enterprise learning platform and the ability to prepare learning paths, taxonomy and metadata for implementation.

Experience supporting learning initiatives across multiple markets and languages, including quality assurance and maintenance of localized content.

Ability to lead the design work independently and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts and learning teams.

Experience delivering implementation-ready specifications, editable assets and clear handover documentation so internal teams can maintain and develop the Academy over time.

What we Offer
Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

Additional compensation during parental leave

Occupational health services

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We’re Northern Europe's leading provider of outstanding, modular spaces for a more flexible, low-carbon future.

From high-speed trains, metros, monorails and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Welder for collision damage – your next challenge in Västerås!
Are you a welder who thrives on challenges? Alstom is now looking for a new colleague who will work with repairs of damaged and crash-damaged vehicles in a dynamic and exciting environment.
 
Your future role
You will report to the Production Leader and work together with a dedicated and competent team.
The group in the workshop consists of about 12 people and is a mix of both welders/blacksmiths and modification technicians (fitters). You will get good support and support from our colleagues from other functions such as engineering, industrialisation engineering, quality and purchasing.
In this role, you will be an important part of the problem-solving process and we are looking for someone who has a passion for finding effective solutions. Your creativity and initiative are crucial to our daily work.
 
The position includes, among other things:
Replacing and aligning body parts
Welding, gluing and riveting
Disassembling and assembling vehicles

 
You will work with both black and stainless steel as well as aluminum. We would like you to have a few years of experience in welding and be able to read drawings.
 
Who are you?
We value passion and attitude over experience. We don't expect you to have all the skills, but we believe that the following skills will help you succeed and grow in this role:
 
Relevant education or experience in welding
Previous work with welding and repair of vehicles or similar industries
Good knowledge of Black MAG (145 2-12mm) and Stainless Steel MAG (145 2-12mm) to ensure high quality and efficiency in the work
Knowledge of drawing reading and technical specifications related to welding
Worked with welding that has requirements for non-destructive testing, such as Visual Inspection, Penetrant or Magnetic Powder.
Be able to communicate freely in Swedish and good knowledge of English

 
Qualifications:
Welding certificate
Post-Weld Direction
Alu MIG (141 2-12mm), TIG (141) and pin welding (131/111)
Heat direction/cold direction of bumps

Creativity: You have the ability to think outside the box, which helps us find new and innovative solutions to welding-related problems.
Solution-oriented: You quickly identify welding challenges and address them effectively, which is important for keeping our projects on track.
Collaboration-oriented: Your unpretentious approach lifts collaboration in the team and creates a positive work environment where we achieve common goals.

 
The work is carried out during the day, but you should be open to being able to work shifts.

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:   Do you want to help shape the next generation of automation solutions for the mining industry? As a Product Owner within Surface Automation, you will play a key role in translating product strategy and customer needs into clear priorities and tangible results together with our development teams.  Join Our Team
 You will become part of Surface Software Engineering, where we develop advanced automation solutions for Epiroc’s surface products. Here, we work across teams, functions, and countries, bringing together diverse perspectives to create solutions that deliver real value to our customers.
  
 Your Mission
 As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for translating the agreed roadmap, Epics, and objectives into clear team goals and a prioritized backlog. You will represent customer and business value throughout the development process and help the team stay focused on what creates the greatest impact. In this role, you will: 
 Own and continuously prioritize the team’s backlog based on customer and business value.
   
Translate roadmaps, Epics, and objectives into clear priorities, scope, and team goals. 
 
    
Balance new functionality with quality, technical debt, maintenance, security, and risk reduction. 
 
    
Follow development progress and deliveries together with the team, ensuring up-to-date forecasts for Epics and features. 
 
    
Validate outcomes, gather feedback early, and use insights to adjust priorities. 
 
    
Coordinate priorities, dependencies, and releases together with other Product Owners and relevant stakeholders.
 
  
Your ProfileWe are looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer, business, and technology. You create structure and clarity even when circumstances change, and you are comfortable making decisions and balancing competing priorities. At the same time, you are a good listener who builds trust through close collaboration with development teams, Product Management, and other stakeholders. To succeed in this role, we believe you have: 
   
Experience working as a Product Owner, in agile product development, or in a similar role within software, automation, or complex technical systems. 
 
    
The ability to understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear objectives and priorities for development teams. 
 
    
Strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment, prioritize among competing demands, and drive initiatives to decisions-making.
 
    
Fluency in English is required, both written and verbally 
 
  
 
 You do not need to be the person defining the technical solution yourself. You will work closely with developers, architects, and other technical experts who contribute feasibility assessments, estimates, risk analyses, and solution decisions. Your strength lies in creating clarity around needs, value, and priorities. Experience with industrial automation, autonomous solutions, mining operations, or other safety-critical and complex products is considered an advantage.
 Location and TravelThis position is based in Örebro, Sweden. Travel may be required when needed.
  
 In addition to a culture characterized by growth and development combined with a healthy work-life balance, there are a few things that make us especially proud to work at Epiroc:
  Global career opportunities.
 Epiroc University for your ongoing professional development.
 Community engagement.
 A comprehensive benefits package, including flexible working hours and bonus programs.A Hybrid Workplace Life at Epiroc may include the opportunity for a hybrid workplace. This way of working offers flexibility and inclusion, enabling a better balance between work and personal life while promoting well-being. The hybrid work model is available when the nature of the job allows it, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual circumstances.
  
Application and Contact Information We encourage you to submit your application through our career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 29, 2025.
 We are committed to a thorough recruitment process that includes interviews, reference checks, and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity verification as well as drug and alcohol testing. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive, and you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

About the Opportunity
We are looking for a motivated and commercially minded professional to support the development and expansion of our business into the Medical Technology (MedTech) sector.
Our ambition is to identify opportunities in medical technology and digital health, develop innovative healthcare solutions, establish strategic partnerships and access funding through European Union programmes, Swedish innovation agencies and other international funding organisations.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a background or interest in medicine, healthcare, life sciences, digital health, business development or innovation who wants to contribute to building a new business area.
The successful candidate will work closely with company management to identify opportunities, develop partnerships, research funding programmes and support the development of commercially viable healthcare projects.
Key Responsibilities
1. MedTech Business Development
Research opportunities in medical technology, digital health and healthcare innovation.
Identify promising medical products, technologies and business opportunities.
Support market research, competitor analysis and business planning.
Contribute to the development of the company's MedTech business strategy.

2. EU Funding and Grants
Identify relevant European and Swedish funding opportunities.
Research programmes such as Horizon Europe, EIC Accelerator, Eurostars, EIT Health and Vinnova.
Assist with preparing funding applications, project proposals, budgets and supporting documentation.
Support the development of collaborative projects with potential funding partners.

3. Partnerships and Networking
Identify and establish relationships with hospitals, universities, research institutions and healthcare organisations.
Develop contacts with medical technology companies, manufacturers and distributors.
Support international partnerships and collaborative innovation projects.

4. Project Development and Coordination
Assist in developing and coordinating MedTech projects.
Support project planning, timelines, budgets and reporting.
Research medical device regulatory requirements, including EU MDR and IVDR, and coordinate with relevant specialists when needed.
Contribute to business development plans and project recommendations.

Qualifications and Experience
We welcome applications from candidates with educational or professional backgrounds in one or more of the following:
Medicine, healthcare or clinical practice.
Medical technology or medical device development.
Life sciences, biomedical sciences or biotechnology.
Digital health, health informatics or healthcare IT.
Business development, innovation or project management.

Essential skills:
Good understanding of healthcare, medical services or healthcare technologies.
Strong research, analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Good written and spoken English.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Ability to work independently, take initiative and coordinate projects.
Genuine interest in healthcare innovation and business development.

The following are advantages but not mandatory:
Experience in healthcare business development or partnerships.
Exposure to EU funding programmes such as Horizon Europe, Eurostars or EIC.
Experience supporting grant applications or funded projects.
Knowledge of Swedish innovation funding, including Vinnova.
Basic understanding of EU MDR, IVDR and CE-marking processes.
Knowledge of the Swedish or Nordic healthcare and MedTech markets.

What We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone proactive, entrepreneurial and interested in developing new business opportunities.
We do not expect the successful candidate to be an established MedTech executive or an expert in all areas of EU funding and medical device regulation.
We value healthcare knowledge, business development potential, initiative, strong research skills and a willingness to learn and develop specialist expertise.
Initial Objectives
During the first six months, the successful candidate will contribute to:
Assessing opportunities in the Swedish and European MedTech markets.
Identifying potential healthcare innovation and technology projects.
Mapping relevant Swedish and European funding opportunities.
Establishing relationships with potential research, healthcare and industry partners.
Supporting the preparation of suitable funding applications.
Developing a preliminary MedTech business development and 12–24-month roadmap.

What We Offer
An opportunity to help establish and develop a new business area.
Direct collaboration with company management.
Opportunities to develop expertise in MedTech, EU funding and healthcare innovation.
International networking and partnership opportunities.
Scope for increased responsibility and professional growth as the business develops.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and a short description of their relevant experience and interest in MedTech.
Examples of healthcare projects, business development activities, partnerships or funding applications are welcome.
We are particularly interested in candidates who combine healthcare knowledge, business development potential and an interest in turning healthcare challenges into innovative and commercially viable solutions.

jobs.occupation: Junior Structural Analysis Engineer – Marine Technology
jobs.description:
Work with large-scale moving structures where structural analysis, advanced mechanics and material engineering come together. Help develop innovative wind-powered technology for more energy-efficient shipping, taking your calculations and design solutions all the way to full-scale applications. As part of a small engineering team, you'll have the freedom to influence the product and take ownership from day one. Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, you'll get to tackle complex engineering challenges while developing your technical expertise.
About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Structural Analysis Engineer to join an innovative technology company in Stockholm, developing large-scale mechanical systems for more sustainable shipping. The company combines advanced engineering, mechanical design and material technology to create solutions that harness wind power and reduce fuel consumption in the maritime industry.
In this role, you will focus on developing and improving existing products, making complex mechanical structures lighter, more efficient and easier to manufacture. Your work will range from detailed structural calculations and smaller design improvements to evaluating major design changes and new technical concepts.
You will work closely with mechanical engineers and other specialists in a small, collaborative development team. The products involve large moving structures exposed to demanding environmental conditions, where loads, movement, material properties and mechanical functionality must all be considered.
What makes this opportunity particularly exciting is the ability to influence the actual product. Your calculations and technical assessments will directly contribute to design decisions, and you will have the opportunity to follow your work through development, manufacturing and testing. With a high level of responsibility and freedom, you will play an active role in shaping both the technical solutions and the final product.
Key Responsibilities
Perform structural calculations and analyses of large-scale mechanical structures and components.
Analyze and optimize designs with regard to strength, weight, functionality and manufacturability.
Evaluate how different loads, movements and material properties affect structural performance.
Prepare calculation reports and technical documentation to support engineering decisions.
Work with calculation and simulation tools, including opportunities to develop and improve analysis methods.
Evaluate design alternatives and contribute to technical solutions in close collaboration with mechanical engineers.
Participate in product development, from early concepts and design iterations to final solutions and testing.

About You
A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, Engineering Mechanics, Marine Engineering or a related field.
A solid understanding of structural mechanics, strength of materials and mechanical behavior under different loads.
Experience with structural calculations and analysis, gained through academic projects or professional work.
An interest in mechanical design and understanding how individual components contribute to the performance of a complete system.
Good communication skills in English.

It is considered an advantage if you have experience with finite element analysis (FEA), ANSYS, Python or similar engineering calculation tools. Experience with large mechanical structures, moving systems, hydraulics, steel or composite materials is also valuable. A background in marine engineering, offshore, heavy industry or working with DNV standards would be particularly relevant.
As a person, you are self-driven, curious and comfortable taking responsibility for your own work. You enjoy getting into the technical details of calculations while maintaining an understanding of the bigger picture. You take initiative, explore different solutions and are motivated by seeing your engineering work turn into real, functioning products.
About the employment
This is a consultancy assignment, which means that you will initially be employed by Friday. The shared intention of Friday and our client is for you to transition to direct employment with the client after 12 months.
Applicants who already have the legal right to work in Sweden will be prioritized. Work permit sponsorship may be considered in exceptional cases.
Practical information
Employment: Full-time
Start date: By agreement
Location: Stockholm, Flemmingsberg
Salary: Market-aligned monthly salary
Contact person: Anna Persson

About Friday
Friday connects technical specialists with companies where their knowledge and ambitions can develop over time. We take the time to understand what you are looking for and match you with roles that fit both your experience and your next career step.
We value potential and ambition and work actively toward an inclusive recruitment process in which candidates are assessed on relevant qualifications and experience.
Friday has offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Linköping and Örebro. Each year, we conduct more than 5,000 career meetings and recruit technical specialists for organisations ranging from international companies to growing technology businesses.
